comparison.objective: Seat a shower cartridge against O-rings and install its retaining U-clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial force control plus transverse clip insertion while maintaining cartridge seating.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge is flush and retained by the clip, including a pull check after release.
comparison.reason: This is compact seal compression and single-clip retention. The candidate requires two-site rail installation, rack-unit leveling, telescoping, four spring-prong engagements, and prescribed screws.
